t.E968.agn: In 2023 EFSA set the acceptable daily intake (ADI) at 0.5 g/kg body weight based on the laxative (diarrhoea-inducing) effect and reported that estimated intake in children and adolescents is above this value.
t.E968.body: It is readily absorbed in the body and most of it is excreted unchanged in the urine.
t.E968.eff.0.a: Above 0.5 g/kg body weight per day
t.E968.eff.0.t: May cause diarrhoea (laxative effect); EFSA's daily limit is based on this effect
t.E968.eff.1.t: Estimated intake above the daily limit
t.E968.eval: In its 2023 re-evaluation, EFSA set the ADI at 0.5 g/kg body weight/day (based on the diarrhoea/laxative effect) and reported that estimated intake is above this value. A study published in 2023 reported an association between blood erythritol levels and cardiovascular events; causality has not been proven.
t.E968.prod: Produced by fermentation of glucose with yeast.
t.E968.regx.0: ADI 0.5 g/kg; estimated intake above the limit.
t.E968.summary: An almost calorie-free polyol produced by fermentation. Used in sugar-free drinks and desserts, often together with stevia.
t.E968.what: An almost calorie-free sugar alcohol (polyol); it gives sweetness to sugar-free products.
